ETH.note: The budget record describes a research and infrastructure mandate, not a mandate over AI harms.
No government use of an AI system is stated.
No sectoral AI system is stated.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's 2024/25 budget record gives the Artificial Intelligence Institution capital projects including a National Artificial Intelligence Datacenter Deployment (ETB 50,000,000), a Computational Center for IOT Project Expansion (ETB 61,672,000) and a National Artificial Intelligence Research Laboratory (ETB 152,649,000).
